response_intelligence.resources_at_risk: Downstream marine zones monitored. Protective booming staging recommended.

forcing_provenance.note: Kinematic demonstration approximation. NOT a real OpenDrift Lagrangian simulation.

investigative_candidates.spatiotemporal_compatibility: HIGH (Intersected probable release envelope within 45 min of estimated release window)
evidence_factors: Closest point of approach: 1.2 km from release envelope centroid
Speed reduction observed: dropped from 14.2 kn to 7.8 kn in vicinity
Heading alignment consistent with initial slick orientation streak
investigative_candidates.limitations: Synthetic demo track. Proximity is not proof of discharge; physical sampling or aerial sheen confirmation required.

investigative_candidates.spatiotemporal_compatibility: MODERATE (Track passed 4.8 km south of release envelope)
evidence_factors: Passed within regional corridor 2.5 hours prior to observation
investigative_candidates.limitations: Synthetic demo track. Trajectory compatibility is marginal; lower investigative priority.

uncertainty_and_limitations.detection_uncertainty: Empirical OIL_EVIDENCE_SCORE from SmallUNet. Real-world generalization not yet validated.
uncertainty_and_limitations.drift_uncertainty: Demo trajectory approximation. In real operations, coupled OpenDrift with audited NetCDF wind/current forcing is mandatory.
uncertainty_and_limitations.attribution_uncertainty: Strictly investigative candidate prioritization. AIS presence alone never constitutes proof of discharge.
